labelProvenance: Construction-based labels authored for original synthetic drawings from the descriptions and measurement ranges of the Stage A seed. A grade of 2 indicates a close construction match in the selected region and a grade of 1 indicates an adaptable match with a meaningful difference. Labels were assigned before running retrieval. These are synthetic labels, without independent human grading.

cases.description: Cowl-neck bias slip in a burgundy and cream blossom print
cases.labelRationale: Claude supplies a bias-draped cowl without darts or a waist seam. Meadow shares the burgundy blossom surface but its crew neck and straight knit block cannot reproduce the folded cowl.

cases.description: Plaid sweetheart sheath with visible contour seams
cases.labelRationale: Inès supplies the sweetheart and boned princess bodice. Brier shares the rust and olive plaid surface but has a camp collar, button front and no fitted princess panel.

cases.description: Cropped darted square-neck blouse with tie tails
cases.labelRationale: Linden shares the cropped square neckline, shaping darts and back tie. Solène is a cross-category option with the same square neckline and darts, but adds a natural-waist seam.

cases.description: Knee dress with short set-in puff sleeves and cuff bands
cases.labelRationale: Paloma has the short cap-gathered sleeve and band cuff. Solène and Linden share the set-in puff construction with different cuff treatments, and Solène adds sleeve length.

cases.description: Keyhole blouse with raglan bishop sleeves
cases.labelRationale: Céleste shares the long, elastic-cuffed raglan bishop sleeve. The bishop maxi view of Vesper shares the shape and length with a set-in armhole and tailored cuff.

cases.description: Fitted ballet wrap top with narrow full-length sleeves
cases.labelRationale: Juno’s fitted long-sleeve jersey view matches the crossover front, side tie, slim sleeve and hip-length silhouette.

cases.description: Elbow lantern top with deep bands at the sleeve ends
cases.labelRationale: Juno’s second view supplies the set-in elbow lantern whose volume narrows into a band. Cuff and fullness differ substantially from a bishop sleeve.

cases.description: Belted point-collar dress with a curved shirttail
cases.labelRationale: Marigold combines a point collar, full button placket, tie belt, cuffed sleeves and sculpted shirttail skirt.

cases.description: Loose smock with three gathered panels below a raised seam
cases.labelRationale: Cora matches the stepped three-tier construction. Alma adapts the raised seam and gathered volume with one fewer tier and a substantially closer bodice.

cases.description: Boatneck midi with stitched waist and deep skirt box pleats
cases.labelRationale: Noemi supplies a waist-seamed midi with deep box pleats. Circular and gathered skirts require a different pattern cut and distribute fullness differently.

cases.description: Halter tent maxi with a dipped back hem
cases.labelRationale: Rowan supplies a continuous, loose trapeze section and a high-low hem. A waist-seamed A-line would need a different panel layout.

cases.description: Off-shoulder A-line with narrow gore seams and a walking slit
cases.labelRationale: Odette provides the fitted upper skirt, vertical gore seams and released side slit. A fluid bias skirt with a slit lacks the gored structure.

cases.description: Square-neck gathered midi requested for 61-inch bust and 63-inch hip
cases.labelRationale: Solène matches the square bodice, puff sleeves and gathered midi. Only its Curve band contains both 61-inch bust and 63-inch hip measurements.

cases.description: Wide-strap square mini requested for 35-inch bust and 37-inch hip
cases.labelRationale: Solène’s second view combines a wide-strap square bodice with a full skirt at the natural waist. These measurements require its Straight band. Alma supplies the straps and gathers but has a raised shirred waist and longer hem.

cases.description: Band-collar pintuck tunic requested for 63-inch bust and 65-inch hip
cases.labelRationale: Margot supplies a band collar, pintucked front, partial placket and cuffed sleeves. Its Curve Plus band contains both measurements.
